Welcome to Goth Isut, the capital
of the Holy See of Acedia.

rows.label: tlk4632027602_msg0002
rows.name:
The people of Acedia live in peace
and harmony thanks to the teachings
of Malbeni, our beloved Pope.

rows.label: tlk4632027602_msg0003
rows.name:
Perhaps because refugees from Gula
and visitors from abroad have grown,
immoral acts are on the rise.

rows.label: tlk4632027602_msg0004
rows.name:
It is regrettable... If you see anyone
suspicious, please report it to us.
